preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t representing the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ t ≤ 100.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 1 <= n <= 10**12 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each subsequent line contains a positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^12) representing a test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line == '-1' or (output_line.is_integer() and 1 <= int(output_line) <= len(powerful_numbers_up_to_n))) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 (if n cannot be represented as the sum of distinct powerful numbers) or a positive integer k (the minimum number of distinct powerful numbers summing to n).

postconditions.expression: all((n == sum(selected_powerful_numbers) and len(selected_powerful_numbers) == k) or (k == -1 and not any(sum(subset) == n for subset in combinations(powerful_numbers_up_to_n, k))) for n, k, selected_powerful_numbers in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()], [None] * len(stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: If k is not -1, there exists a subset of distinct powerful numbers ≤ n that sum to n with exactly k elements, and no smaller k exists. If k is -1, no such subset exists.
